metadata.description: Document tools for Claude Code and Cowork: recover Markdown from PDFs, and render Markdown with Mermaid diagrams as portable HTML reports.

plugins.name: md-in-pdf2md
plugins.description: PDF → Markdown, for PDFs that were Markdown to begin with. Rebuilds tables, lists and links the PDF flattened, resolves every line-wrap junction as a language judgement instead of a blind join, and gates the result with a character-level fidelity check.

plugins.name: mdbrown
plugins.description: Markdown to a portable HTML report with static Mermaid diagrams, fullscreen zoom and pan, CJK typography, dark mode, print styles, and source verification. 마크다운 HTML 변환 · 머메이드 다이어그램.
